events.title: New fill in buffer zone, north bank
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Fill consolidates and a structure follows; removal becomes costlier and contested
events.detail: Change report CR-02: 488 m² (0.12 acre) of fresh earth fill against orthophoto v1. Field verified on 12 Aug by S. Naidu; no permission on departmental record. Notice drafted, awaiting Nodal Officer signature.
events.action: Sign and serve notice; schedule removal

events.title: Foundation inside FTL, east bank
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Structure completed inside FTL
events.detail: Foundation trench for boundary wall found; work stopped and trench back-filled on 21 Jul.

events.title: Construction debris dumped on west bank
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Debris washes into water spread with the next rain
events.detail: Citizen photo via grievance channel; verified, 6 truckloads removed.

events.title: Dissolved oxygen below alert threshold
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Fish kill risk and odour complaints within 48 hours
events.detail: SN-WQ1 DO fell below 4.0 mg/L at 15 Aug 03:00; lowest 1.08 mg/L at 17 Aug 03:00, with turbidity and conductivity rising together. Raised ahead of routine inspection; field check traced it to Inlet 2 (EV-07).

events.title: BOD above limit in lab report
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Compliance return shows unexplained exceedance
events.detail: LAB-0816 at Inlet 2: BOD 18.5 mg/L. Linked to EV-04 and EV-07.

events.title: Algal bloom visible, north-east bay
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Bloom spreads and oxygen falls further at night
events.detail: Green scum visible over about 0.4 ha in inspection photos; lab sample requested.
events.action: Collect lab sample; check Inlet 2 diversion

events.title: Untreated sewage inlet found at Inlet 2
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Water quality stays degraded; compliance deadline missed
events.detail: New colony outfall connected into Inlet 2 nala. Interim bund placed on 17 Aug. Diversion channel RW-6 not yet started — overdue for mobilisation.

events.title: Abnormal fall in water level
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Undetected leakage through sluice
events.detail: Level fell 0.07 m within the day on 25 Aug; field check found the sluice opened for an authorised irrigation release. No fault.

events.title: Seepage through main bund
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Seepage worsens at high level; bund safety at risk
events.detail: Wet patch 12 m long at toe of bund, chainage 180–192 m, after the 25–28 Jul rain. Covered under RW-4; monitoring weekly.

events.title: Sluice gate damaged
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Uncontrolled release during rain
events.detail: Gate spindle bent; repaired under maintenance.

events.title: Storage loss from siltation
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Flood cushion and storage stay reduced
events.detail: Bathymetry: 1,410 ML at FTL against 1,650 ML design — 14.5% loss. Basis for desilting quantities.

events.title: Desilting reach 2 measured complete
events.detail: Cumulative 22,000 m³ against 22,000 m³ sanctioned; check-measured by M. Rao.

events.title: Fencing behind programme
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Fencing not complete before planned date; encroachment exposure on north bank continues
events.detail: 480 m executed of 2,400 m (20%); planned 70% by mid-September. Contractor cites material delay.
events.action: Review contractor programme; prioritise north bank

events.title: FTL records disagree on north bank
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Removal action on north bank remains contestable
events.detail: See RD-001. Ruling pending.

events.title: Spatial baseline accepted
events.detail: Baseline SB-L01-v1 accepted; custody state moves to baselined.

events.title: Tribunal compliance report due in 14 days
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Late filing before the tribunal; adverse remark on record
events.detail: Quarterly compliance report under fictitious order OA-000/2026 due 25 Sep. Draft generated from pilot data; awaiting review.

events.title: Water quality sensor offline — tamper alert
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Blind period on water quality
events.detail: SN-WQ1 offline 03:00–12:00 on 7 Sep; enclosure opened. Reconnected; lock replaced.

events.title: Weed cover increasing
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Weed mat blocks light and inlet flow
events.detail: Satellite estimate 19% cover in September against 9% in June.

events.title: Rapid rise in water level after heavy rain
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Overtopping risk at low point of bund
events.detail: Level rose 0.87 m after 203 mm rain over 25–28 Jul, peaking at 99.351 m on 28 Jul 21:00 — 0.65 m below FTL. Weir and bund inspected; no overtopping.

events.title: Trees felled in buffer zone
events.consequence_if_not_acted: Loss of green cover precedes encroachment
events.detail: Seven trees felled on south-west buffer; verified. Complaint to be filed with forest officer.
